```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = TRUE,
                      fig.width = 9, fig.height = 6, cache = FALSE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(sf)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(tidyr)
  library(purrr)
  library(readr)
  library(readxl)
  library(janitor)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(brms)
  library(posterior)
})
root_candidates <- c(".", "..")
root_ok <- vapply(root_candidates, function(p)
  file.exists(file.path(p, "data/processed/mod_nb3.7.rds")), logical(1))
stopifnot(any(root_ok))
project_root <- normalizePath(root_candidates[which(root_ok)[1]])
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = project_root)
project_path <- function(...) file.path(project_root, ...)
output_dir <- project_path("outputs/drm_regional_comparison")
cache_dir <- project_path("outputs/cache/drm_regional_comparison")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(cache_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
set.seed(params$seed)
type_levels <- c("Nearshore Ridge Complex", "Inner Reef", "Middle Reef", "Outer Reef")
short_types <- setNames(c("NRC", "IR", "MR", "OR"), type_levels)
se_subregions <- c("Martin", "North Palm Beach", "South Palm Beach", "Broward-Miami")
target_species <- c("CNAT", "DSTO", "DLAB", "MMEA", "MANG", "MALI",
                    "MFER", "MLAM", "PCLI", "PSTR")
taxon_groups <- list(
  PORI = c("PPOR", "PFUR", "PDIV", "PAST", "PORI"),
  ORBI = c("OFAV", "OANN", "OFRA", "ORBI"),
  AGAR = c("AFRA", "AAGA", "AHUM", "ALAM", "AGAR"),
  MADR = c("MAUR", "MSEN", "MDEC", "MPHA", "MADR"),
  SOLE = c("SHYA", "SBOU", "SOLE"),
  SCOL = c("SLAC", "SCUB", "SCOL"),
  SIDE = c("SSID", "SRAD", "SIDE"),
  MYCE = c("MFER", "MLAM", "MALI", "MYCE"),
  OCUL = c("OROB", "ODIF", "OCUL")
)
taxon_lookup <- enframe(taxon_groups, name = "group", value = "species") %>%
  unnest(species)
map_taxon <- function(s) {
  g <- taxon_lookup$group[match(s, taxon_lookup$species)]
  ifelse(is.na(g), s, g)
}
interval_summary <- function(x) {
  tibble(mean = mean(x), lower = unname(quantile(x, .025)),
         upper = unname(quantile(x, .975)))
}
save_table <- function(x, name) {
  write_csv(x, file.path(output_dir, name))
  invisible(x)
}
show_table <- function(x, digits = 5) knitr::kable(x, digits = digits, row.names = FALSE)
```

# Objective and estimand

**Execution status:** This is a draft for joint review. Input preparation,
spatial classification, search-area accounting, and prior matching have been
checked, but the document has not completed a successful regional model fit
or HTML render. The attempted fit stopped during CmdStan compilation. No
posterior comparisons from this new model have been produced. Review the
specification and resolve compilation before interpreting any output as a
completed modeled comparison; preliminary CSVs contain preparation audits only.

This standalone analysis compares **existing modeled 2024 adult coral densities
at Port Everglades (PEV)** with newly modeled adult densities at **other Southeast
Florida DRM sites surveyed in 2024**. The PEV model and its habitat assignments
are read without modification; `analysis/coral_analysis.Rmd` is not sourced or
edited.

For each posterior draw and taxon, predictions for 1 m² in NRC, Inner Reef,
Middle Reef, and Outer Reef receive **equal weight (0.25 each) in both areas**.
This is the same averaging operation used for the main analysis's overall
juvenile/adult estimates (including the 1.09 juveniles m⁻² estimate), applied
here to each adult taxon. It is not a site-count-weighted or habitat-area-weighted
average. The regional sample's observed habitat allocation does not determine
the prediction weights.

The regional reference excludes every PEV metadata site ID, including the
deliberately selected ACER sites. It also excludes DRM PTCH sites, as requested,
and any site not spatially assigned to one of the four reef strata. As a result,
the geographic reference is the **retained, comparable mapped habitats elsewhere
in Southeast Florida**, not an estimate covering every habitat in that region.

# Inputs and habitat source

The regional mapping layer is `SE_FL_Benthic_Habitats_10Nov2015_PBunion`, which
incorporates Walker and Klug (2014), earlier mapping, and subsequent updates.
It retains the `Type` field used by the project's local KML.

- [Public regional habitat layer](https://services1.arcgis.com/nRHtyn3uE1kyzoYc/arcgis/rest/services/SE_Florida_Benthic_Habitats/FeatureServer/0)
- [Regional habitat metadata](https://archive.myfwc.com/archive/Research/GIS/se-fl-benthic-habitats.pdf)
- [Walker and Klug (2014)](https://nsuworks.nova.edu/occ_facreports/87/)
- [DRM survey metadata](https://ocean.floridamarine.org/FRRP/TrainingDocs/DRM_Database_Metadata_2005-2024_Updated_March_2025.pdf)

The versioned local snapshot contains the complete source polygons intersecting
the 179 Southeast Florida DRM site coordinates when retrieved on 2026-10-19.
It is **not the full regional map**. The coordinate audit below stops if the
input site's coordinate footprint changes, rather than treating an incomplete
snapshot as regional map absence. Provenance and original source attributes
are preserved in `data/spatial/drm_regional_habitat/`.

```{r read-inputs}
input_files <- c(
  regional_counts = project_path("data/full_drm_2024/2024.RData"),
  pev_model = project_path("data/processed/mod_nb3.7.rds"),
  pev_counts = project_path("data/processed/all_coral_counts_processed.csv"),
  pev_metadata = project_path("data/2024_shedd_drm/site_metadata.xlsx"),
  polygons = project_path("data/spatial/drm_regional_habitat/habitat_polygons.geojson"),
  snapshot_coordinates = project_path("data/spatial/drm_regional_habitat/snapshot_site_coordinates.csv")
)
stopifnot(all(file.exists(input_files)))
input_hashes <- tibble(input = names(input_files), path = unname(input_files),
                       md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(input_files)))
save_table(input_hashes, "input_checksums.csv")

regional_environment <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
load(input_files[["regional_counts"]], envir = regional_environment)
stopifnot("df24" %in% ls(regional_environment))
drm <- regional_environment$df24 %>%
  transmute(site = sub("^AA", "", as.character(Site)),
            transect = as.integer(Transect),
            date = as.Date(Date), latitude = Latitude, longitude = Longitude,
            subregion = as.character(Subregion), drm_habitat = as.character(Habitat),
            species = as.character(Species), width = Width, height = Height)
se_records <- drm %>% filter(subregion %in% se_subregions)
site_coordinates <- se_records %>% filter(transect %in% 1:2) %>%
  distinct(site, latitude, longitude, subregion, drm_habitat)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(site_coordinates$site),
          all(is.finite(site_coordinates$latitude)),
          all(is.finite(site_coordinates$longitude)))
snapshot_coordinates <- read_csv(input_files[["snapshot_coordinates"]],
                                 show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(site = sub("^AA", "", Site), latitude = Latitude, longitude = Longitude)
uncovered_coordinates <- anti_join(
  select(site_coordinates, site, latitude, longitude), snapshot_coordinates,
  by = c("site", "latitude", "longitude"))
if (nrow(uncovered_coordinates)) {
  save_table(uncovered_coordinates, "coordinates_requiring_snapshot_refresh.csv")
  stop("DRM coordinates have changed: refresh the regional polygon snapshot first.")
}
pev_metadata <- read_xlsx(input_files[["pev_metadata"]], col_types = "text") %>%
  clean_names() %>% mutate(site = as.character(drm_site_id))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(pev_metadata$site))
pev_counts <- read_csv(input_files[["pev_counts"]], show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(site = as.character(site))
pev_fit <- readRDS(input_files[["pev_model"]])
pev_taxa <- sort(unique(as.character(pev_fit$data$taxon[pev_fit$data$class == ">4cm"])))
```

## Spatial assignment and exclusions

The join follows the main analysis: project site coordinates and polygons to a
common CRS, repair polygon geometry, then use `st_within`. Artificial habitat is
pooled with NRC and Aggregated Patch Reef with Outer Reef. ACER patch polygons
are not treated as a habitat, consistent with the main pipeline. Where a reef
polygon overlaps a Sand polygon, the reef class takes precedence, equivalent
to removing reef overlaps from Sand in the local pipeline. Multiple different
accepted reef classes at a site would trigger an error for manual review.

Ridge, Sand, and other nonmatching categories are **not** forced into Outer
Reef. All exclusions and original map labels are exported. Existing PEV
classifications remain unchanged, including AA3075, where this regional map
differs from the local project KML.

```{r classify-habitats}
regional_polygons <- st_read(input_files[["polygons"]], quiet = TRUE) %>%
  st_zm(drop = TRUE, what = "ZM") %>% st_transform(32617) %>% st_make_valid()
site_points <- st_as_sf(site_coordinates, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
                        crs = 4326, remove = FALSE) %>% st_transform(32617)
spatial_hits <- st_join(site_points,
                       select(regional_polygons, Type, Modifier), join = st_within) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>% mutate(mapped_type = case_when(
    Type == "Artificial" ~ "Nearshore Ridge Complex",
    Type == "Aggregated Patch Reef" ~ "Outer Reef",
    TRUE ~ as.character(Type)))
site_audit <- spatial_hits %>%
  group_by(site, latitude, longitude, subregion, drm_habitat) %>%
  summarise(source_types = paste(sort(unique(na.omit(Type))), collapse = "; "),
            source_modifiers = paste(sort(unique(na.omit(Modifier))), collapse = "; "),
            reef_types = list(sort(unique(mapped_type[mapped_type %in% type_levels]))),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(n_reef_types = lengths(reef_types),
         Type = map_chr(reef_types, function(x) if (length(x) == 1) x else NA_character_),
         is_pev = site %in% pev_metadata$site,
         exclusion = case_when(
           is_pev ~ "PEV site: excluded from independent regional reference",
           drm_habitat == "PTCH" ~ "DRM PTCH: explicitly excluded",
           n_reef_types > 1 ~ "Conflicting reef classes: manual review required",
           n_reef_types == 0 & source_types == "" ~ "Outside cached polygons",
           n_reef_types == 0 ~ "Mapped category outside the four reef strata",
           TRUE ~ "Retained")) %>% select(-reef_types)
save_table(site_audit, "site_classification_audit.csv")
if (any(site_audit$n_reef_types > 1 & !site_audit$is_pev))
  stop("Conflicting reef classes require review; see site_classification_audit.csv.")
regional_sites <- site_audit %>% filter(exclusion == "Retained") %>%
  mutate(Type = factor(Type, levels = type_levels),
         dir = factor(if_else(latitude > 26.093570, "N", "S"), levels = c("N", "S")))
stopifnot(!any(regional_sites$site %in% pev_metadata$site),
          !anyDuplicated(regional_sites$site),
          all(type_levels %in% regional_sites$Type))
save_table(regional_sites, "regional_site_metadata.csv")
show_table(count(site_audit, exclusion))
show_table(count(regional_sites, Type, .drop = FALSE))
```

The snapshot used here retains `r nrow(regional_sites)` non-PEV sites.
The main PEV model's 2024 sample has the distribution shown below. These sample
counts are reported for transparency; **the comparison weights remain 0.25 in
each habitat**. PEV's 2024 Outer Reef density is estimated through the existing
multi-dataset model, without a direct local Outer Reef survey that year.

```{r weights}
pev_site_metadata <- pev_counts %>% filter(dataset == "drm24") %>% distinct(site, Type)
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(pev_site_metadata$site))
habitat_weights <- tibble(Type = type_levels, weight = rep(.25, 4)) %>%
  left_join(count(pev_site_metadata, Type, name = "pev_2024_sites"), by = "Type") %>%
  left_join(count(regional_sites, Type, name = "regional_2024_sites"), by = "Type") %>%
  mutate(across(ends_with("sites"), ~ replace_na(.x, 0L)))
stopifnot(abs(sum(habitat_weights$weight) - 1) < 1e-12)
save_table(habitat_weights, "habitat_weights.csv")
show_table(habitat_weights)

# Detect coordinate duplicates under different IDs across the two samples.
coordinate_duplicates <- inner_join(
  select(regional_sites, regional_site = site, latitude, longitude),
  site_coordinates %>% filter(site %in% pev_metadata$site) %>%
    select(pev_site = site, latitude, longitude), by = c("latitude", "longitude"))
save_table(coordinate_duplicates, "cross_sample_coordinate_duplicates.csv")
stopifnot(nrow(coordinate_duplicates) == 0)
```

# Adult counts, taxonomic harmonization, and effort

Each colony is retained as a record, even when species and dimensions match
another colony. Adults follow the main analysis's rule: maximum of width and
height ≥4 cm. The existing `>4cm` label in the PEV model includes colonies of
exactly 4 cm. A site-level count is generated for every modeled taxon, including
observed zeros. Missing colony rows for a zero-coral transect do not imply that
the transect was not surveyed.

All species were searched on T1–T2 (20 m²/site). The ten target species were
also searched on T3–T4 (40 m²/site). PEV's additional ACER/Orbicella bonus
transects are already accounted for in its saved model; those extra efforts
are **not** assumed for the regional surveys. Genus aggregation follows the
main pipeline exactly. Extra regional taxa without a saved PEV adult posterior
can be modeled regionally but cannot receive a PEV contrast.

```{r prepare-counts}
retained_records <- se_records %>% filter(site %in% regional_sites$site)
missing_sizes <- retained_records %>% filter(!is.na(species), species != "",
                                           is.na(width) & is.na(height))
save_table(missing_sizes, "colonies_missing_both_size_measurements.csv")
stopifnot(nrow(missing_sizes) == 0)
adult_records <- retained_records %>%
  filter(!is.na(species), species != "", pmax(width, height, na.rm = TRUE) >= 4,
         transect %in% 1:2 | (transect %in% 3:4 & species %in% target_species)) %>%
  mutate(taxon = map_taxon(species))
unexpected_extra_transects <- retained_records %>%
  filter(transect %in% 3:4, !is.na(species), !species %in% target_species)
save_table(unexpected_extra_transects, "nontarget_records_on_T3_T4.csv")
stopifnot(nrow(unexpected_extra_transects) == 0)

# MYCE combines the three searched target Mycetophyllia species. A generic
# MYCE record would have ambiguous extra-transect effort and requires review.
stopifnot(!any(adult_records$species == "MYCE"))
model_taxa <- sort(union(pev_taxa, unique(adult_records$taxon)))
effort_lookup <- tibble(taxon = model_taxa) %>%
  mutate(transect_area_m2 = if_else(taxon %in% union(target_species, "MYCE"), 40, 20))
regional_counts <- expand_grid(site = regional_sites$site, taxon = model_taxa) %>%
  left_join(count(adult_records, site, taxon, name = "n"), by = c("site", "taxon")) %>%
  mutate(n = replace_na(n, 0L)) %>%
  left_join(effort_lookup, by = "taxon") %>%
  left_join(select(regional_sites, site, Type, dir, subregion), by = "site") %>%
  mutate(taxon = factor(taxon, levels = model_taxa),
         Type = factor(Type, levels = type_levels))
stopifnot(nrow(regional_counts) == nrow(regional_sites) * length(model_taxa),
          all(regional_counts$n >= 0), all(regional_counts$n == floor(regional_counts$n)),
          !anyNA(regional_counts),
          sum(regional_counts$n) == nrow(adult_records))
save_table(regional_counts, "regional_site_taxon_counts.csv")
taxon_coverage <- regional_counts %>% group_by(taxon) %>%
  summarise(colonies = sum(n), positive_sites = sum(n > 0), sites = n(),
            searched_m2_per_site = first(transect_area_m2), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(has_pev_adult_posterior = as.character(taxon) %in% pev_taxa)
save_table(taxon_coverage, "taxon_coverage.csv")
show_table(taxon_coverage, digits = 0)

raw_habitat_summary <- regional_counts %>% group_by(taxon, Type) %>%
  summarise(sites = n(), colonies = sum(n), positive_sites = sum(n > 0),
            raw_mean_density = mean(n / transect_area_m2), .groups = "drop")
save_table(raw_habitat_summary, "raw_habitat_summary.csv")
```

# Regional density model

The regional model uses the same **zero-inflated negative-binomial family**,
taxon × habitat effects on expected counts, zero inflation and dispersion,
log surveyed-area offset, and prior distributions as the main PEV analysis.
The adult-only formula omits the constant size-class term. It retains the
taxon × habitat × north/south spatial random intercept, using the main
analysis's latitude split at 26.093570° N.

There is only one regional dataset/year. The main model's dataset random
intercepts/slopes and dataset × taxon × class random intercept cannot be
separately estimated here and are omitted. This is the necessary single-year
adaptation, not a claim that the fitted models are identical. The main model
is not refit and no regional data are added to its posterior.

For predictions, spatial random effects are set to zero in both models,
matching the main pipeline's `re_formula` convention. This is **not numerical
integration over the spatial random-effect distribution**. Expected predictions
include both components of the zero-inflated likelihood.

```{r model-specification}
regional_formula <- bf(
  n ~ taxon * Type + (1 | taxon:Type:dir) + offset(log(transect_area_m2)),
  zi ~ taxon * Type,
  shape ~ taxon * Type
)
regional_priors <- c(
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = "b"),
  prior(normal(-2.8, 1.8), class = "Intercept"),
  prior(logistic(0, 1), class = "Intercept", dpar = "zi"),
  prior(normal(1.5, 2.5), class = "b", dpar = "zi"),
  prior(student_t(3, 0, 2.5), class = "Intercept", dpar = "shape"),
  prior(normal(-0.9, 1), class = "b", dpar = "shape"),
  prior(exponential(4), class = "sd")
)
# Check the priors actually saved in the PEV fit, rather than interpreting
# comments in the old fitting chunk as the fitted prior specification.
saved_priors <- as.data.frame(pev_fit$prior)
saved_priors <- saved_priors[saved_priors$coef == "" & saved_priors$group == "" &
                               saved_priors$class %in% c("b", "Intercept", "sd"), ]
specified_priors <- as.data.frame(regional_priors)
prior_validation <- specified_priors %>% select(class, dpar, prior) %>%
  left_join(saved_priors %>% select(class, dpar, pev_prior = prior),
            by = c("class", "dpar")) %>% mutate(matches = prior == pev_prior)
save_table(prior_validation, "prior_validation_against_pev_fit.csv")
stopifnot(all(prior_validation$matches), !anyNA(prior_validation$matches))
# Cache is invalidated by model data, specification, settings, and brms version.
model_signature <- list(data = regional_counts, formula = regional_formula,
                        priors = regional_priors, params = params[names(params) != "refit_model"],
                        brms_version = as.character(packageVersion("brms")))
signature_path <- tempfile(fileext = ".rds")
saveRDS(model_signature, signature_path)
model_hash <- unname(tools::md5sum(signature_path))
unlink(signature_path)
fit_base <- file.path(cache_dir, paste0("regional_adults_", model_hash))
fit_file <- paste0(fit_base, ".rds")
if (file.exists(fit_file) && !isTRUE(params$refit_model)) {
  regional_fit <- readRDS(fit_file)
} else {
  regional_fit <- brm(
    formula = regional_formula, data = regional_counts,
    family = zero_inflated_negbinomial(), prior = regional_priors,
    chains = params$chains, cores = min(params$cores, params$chains),
    iter = params$iter, warmup = params$warmup,
    backend = "cmdstanr", seed = params$seed,
    control = list(adapt_delta = .99, max_treedepth = 12),
    file = fit_base, file_refit = "always", refresh = 250
  )
}
saveRDS(model_signature, file.path(cache_dir, "last_model_signature.rds"))
```

## Convergence and posterior predictive checks

Diagnostics are saved and reported before contrasts. Differences are
exploratory if the model has unresolved sampling diagnostics. The criterion
used here is maximum parameter R-hat ≤1.01, minimum bulk and tail ESS ≥400,
zero divergent transitions, and zero maximum-treedepth hits.

```{r model-diagnostics}
diagnostic_draws <- posterior::as_draws_array(regional_fit)
parameter_diagnostics <- posterior::summarise_draws(diagnostic_draws) %>%
  filter(variable != "lp__", !grepl("^lprior", variable))
save_table(parameter_diagnostics, "regional_parameter_diagnostics.csv")
nuts <- nuts_params(regional_fit)
sampling_diagnostics <- tibble(
  max_rhat = max(parameter_diagnostics$rhat, na.rm = TRUE),
  min_bulk_ess = min(parameter_diagnostics$ess_bulk, na.rm = TRUE),
  min_tail_ess = min(parameter_diagnostics$ess_tail, na.rm = TRUE),
  divergences = sum(nuts$Value[nuts$Parameter == "divergent__"]),
  max_treedepth_hits = sum(nuts$Value[nuts$Parameter == "treedepth__"] >= 12)) %>%
  mutate(diagnostics_pass = max_rhat <= 1.01 & min_bulk_ess >= 400 &
           min_tail_ess >= 400 & divergences == 0 & max_treedepth_hits == 0)
save_table(sampling_diagnostics, "regional_sampling_diagnostics.csv")
show_table(sampling_diagnostics, digits = 3)
if (!sampling_diagnostics$diagnostics_pass)
  warning("Regional model diagnostics need review; contrasts are provisional.")

set.seed(params$seed + 1)
yrep <- posterior_predict(regional_fit, ndraws = 500)
observed_density <- regional_counts$n / regional_counts$transect_area_m2
rep_density <- sweep(yrep, 2, regional_counts$transect_area_m2, "/")
ppc <- tibble(
  taxon = as.character(regional_counts$taxon),
  Type = as.character(regional_counts$Type),
  observed = observed_density, observed_zero = regional_counts$n == 0,
  replicated_mean = colMeans(rep_density),
  replicated_zero = colMeans(yrep == 0)) %>%
  group_by(taxon, Type) %>%
  summarise(across(c(observed, observed_zero, replicated_mean, replicated_zero), mean),
            .groups = "drop")
save_table(ppc, "posterior_predictive_checks.csv")
ppc_plot <- ggplot(ppc, aes(observed, replicated_mean, color = Type)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "grey65") + geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "sqrt") + scale_y_continuous(trans = "sqrt") +
  labs(x = "Observed mean adult density", y = "Posterior predictive mean density",
       color = "Habitat") + theme_bw()
ppc_plot
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "posterior_predictive_means.png"), ppc_plot,
       width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 200)
```

# Habitat-specific modeled densities and PEV validation

PEV predictions reproduce the main analysis's 2024 prediction grid and retained
dataset effects. Only the adult taxon/size combinations actually in the saved
model are requested. The existing formatted Table A3 adult habitat means are
checked against reconstructed PEV predictions, preventing an unnoticed change
to the local estimand.

```{r predictions}
regional_newdata <- expand_grid(taxon = model_taxa, Type = type_levels) %>%
  mutate(transect_area_m2 = 1)
regional_epred <- posterior_epred(regional_fit, newdata = regional_newdata,
                                 re_formula = NA)
pev_newdata <- expand_grid(taxon = pev_taxa, class = ">4cm", Type = type_levels) %>%
  mutate(dataset = "drm24", transect_area_m2 = 1)
pev_epred <- posterior_epred(
  pev_fit, newdata = pev_newdata,
  re_formula = ~(1 + Type | dataset) + (1 | dataset:taxon:class))

summarize_grid <- function(pred, grid, area) {
  bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(grid)), function(i) {
    bind_cols(tibble(area = area, taxon = as.character(grid$taxon[i]),
                     Type = as.character(grid$Type[i])), interval_summary(pred[, i]))
  }))
}
habitat_estimates <- bind_rows(
  summarize_grid(pev_epred, pev_newdata, "Port Everglades"),
  summarize_grid(regional_epred, regional_newdata, "Other Southeast Florida"))
save_table(habitat_estimates, "modeled_habitat_densities.csv")

existing_table <- read_csv(project_path("outputs/TableA3.csv"),
                           show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(class == ">4cm") %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(taxon, class), names_to = "Type", values_to = "formatted") %>%
  mutate(existing_mean = as.numeric(sub(" .*", "", formatted)))
pev_validation <- existing_table %>%
  left_join(filter(habitat_estimates, area == "Port Everglades"), by = c("taxon", "Type")) %>%
  mutate(reconstructed_rounded = as.numeric(sprintf("%.2g", mean)),
         matches = abs(existing_mean - reconstructed_rounded) < 1e-10)
save_table(pev_validation, "pev_existing_estimate_validation.csv")
stopifnot(nrow(pev_validation) == length(pev_taxa) * 4,
          all(pev_validation$matches), !anyNA(pev_validation$matches))
```

# Equal-four-habitat posterior comparisons

Both independent fits produce posterior expected densities. Regional posterior
draws are randomly paired with PEV draws, using the same pairing for all taxa
and habitats. Averaging and differencing occur **within draws**, retaining
within-model covariance across habitats and taxa. These are modeled comparisons
on both sides; no regional raw mean or bootstrap substitutes for its posterior.

A difference is PEV − regional density. The results include 95% equal-tailed
credible intervals for each mean and difference, a density ratio, and
P(PEV > regional). A difference interval including zero is **not** evidence of
equivalence. Intervals are taxon-specific and not multiplicity-adjusted;
the continuous posterior probabilities should be considered alongside them.

```{r contrasts}
common_taxa <- intersect(pev_taxa, model_taxa)
regional_only_taxa <- setdiff(model_taxa, pev_taxa)
save_table(tibble(taxon = regional_only_taxa,
                 reason = "No existing PEV adult posterior; regional estimate only"),
           "regional_only_taxa.csv")
weighted_draws <- function(pred, grid, taxa) {
  out <- vapply(taxa, function(tax) {
    cols <- which(as.character(grid$taxon) == tax)
    stopifnot(length(cols) == 4,
              setequal(as.character(grid$Type[cols]), type_levels))
    w <- habitat_weights$weight[match(as.character(grid$Type[cols]), habitat_weights$Type)]
    as.vector(pred[, cols, drop = FALSE] %*% w)
  }, numeric(nrow(pred)))
  colnames(out) <- taxa
  out
}
pev_weighted <- weighted_draws(pev_epred, pev_newdata, common_taxa)
regional_weighted <- weighted_draws(regional_epred, regional_newdata, common_taxa)
n_joint <- min(nrow(pev_weighted), nrow(regional_weighted))
set.seed(params$seed + 2)
pev_indices <- sample(seq_len(nrow(pev_weighted)), n_joint, replace = FALSE)
regional_indices <- sample(seq_len(nrow(regional_weighted)), n_joint, replace = FALSE)
pev_joint <- pev_weighted[pev_indices, , drop = FALSE]
regional_joint <- regional_weighted[regional_indices, , drop = FALSE]
stopifnot(all(is.finite(pev_joint)), all(is.finite(regional_joint)),
          all(pev_joint > 0), all(regional_joint > 0))
make_contrast <- function(taxon, local, regional) {
  difference <- local - regional
  ratio <- local / regional
  tibble(taxon = taxon,
         pev_mean = mean(local), pev_lower = quantile(local, .025, names = FALSE),
         pev_upper = quantile(local, .975, names = FALSE),
         regional_mean = mean(regional), regional_lower = quantile(regional, .025, names = FALSE),
         regional_upper = quantile(regional, .975, names = FALSE),
         difference_mean = mean(difference),
         difference_lower = quantile(difference, .025, names = FALSE),
         difference_upper = quantile(difference, .975, names = FALSE),
         ratio_median = median(ratio), ratio_lower = quantile(ratio, .025, names = FALSE),
         ratio_upper = quantile(ratio, .975, names = FALSE),
         probability_pev_above = mean(difference > 0),
         probability_pev_below = mean(difference < 0), posterior_pairs = length(difference))
}
comparisons <- bind_rows(lapply(common_taxa, function(tax)
  make_contrast(tax, pev_joint[, tax], regional_joint[, tax]))) %>%
  mutate(direction = case_when(difference_lower > 0 ~ "PEV higher",
                               difference_upper < 0 ~ "PEV lower",
                               TRUE ~ "Difference uncertain"),
         regional_diagnostics_pass = sampling_diagnostics$diagnostics_pass)
save_table(comparisons, "equal_habitat_taxon_comparisons.csv")
saveRDS(list(weights = habitat_weights, taxa = common_taxa,
             pev_draws = pev_joint, regional_draws = regional_joint,
             model_hash = model_hash, seed = params$seed),
        file.path(cache_dir, "comparison_posterior_draws.rds"))
format_interval <- function(m, lo, hi) sprintf("%.5f [%.5f, %.5f]", m, lo, hi)
display_comparisons <- comparisons %>% transmute(
  Taxon = taxon,
  `PEV 2024 [95% CrI]` = format_interval(pev_mean, pev_lower, pev_upper),
  `Other SE Florida [95% CrI]` = format_interval(regional_mean, regional_lower, regional_upper),
  `PEV minus regional [95% CrI]` = format_interval(difference_mean, difference_lower, difference_upper),
  `P(PEV > regional)` = round(probability_pev_above, 4), Interpretation = direction)
save_table(display_comparisons, "formatted_taxon_comparisons.csv")
show_table(display_comparisons)
```

```{r comparison-figure, fig.height=8}
comparison_plot <- ggplot(comparisons,
  aes(y = reorder(taxon, difference_mean), x = difference_mean,
      xmin = difference_lower, xmax = difference_upper, color = direction)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 2, color = "grey55") +
  geom_errorbar(orientation = "y", width = .2) + geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("PEV higher" = "#2166AC", "PEV lower" = "#B2182B",
                                "Difference uncertain" = "#666666")) +
  labs(x = expression("PEV minus other SE Florida density (colonies " * m^{-2} * ")"),
       y = NULL, color = NULL,
       subtitle = "2024 modeled densities; equal weights across NRC, IR, MR, OR; 95% CrI") +
  theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
comparison_plot
ggsave(file.path(output_dir, "equal_habitat_density_differences.png"), comparison_plot,
       width = 9, height = 8, dpi = 250)
```

## Sum of common modeled adult taxa

The following sum covers only taxa with an existing PEV adult posterior. It
is not necessarily total density of all coral species observed in either
survey. It is computed by summing taxon densities within posterior draws.

```{r common-taxa-sum}
common_taxa_sum <- make_contrast("Sum of common modeled adult taxa",
                                rowSums(pev_joint), rowSums(regional_joint))
save_table(common_taxa_sum, "sum_common_modeled_adult_taxa.csv")
show_table(common_taxa_sum)
```

# Interpretation and limits

The equal-habitat comparison estimates a standardized density, not average
density over the actual mapped habitat area or observed site allocation.
PEV's 2024 Outer Reef predictions are extrapolations from its multi-dataset
model. Sparse taxa and habitat combinations need particular attention in the
predictive checks. Spatial effects are set to zero on both sides, following
the main pipeline; this removes the north/south offsets but does not address
all possible survey-design or subregional differences.

The regional model uses a single year and excludes mapped categories outside
the four reef strata. It cannot represent the Martin and North Palm Beach
sites that map to Ridge or Sand under this source layer. The older local KML
and regional map differ at least at PEV site AA3075; the existing local fit
and its assignments are deliberately preserved.

PEV site 3095 has no adult-survey rows in the source adult workbooks but is
zero-filled in the existing processed data. Its status should be checked
before final manuscript integration. This document does not change or refit
that saved model. Existing modeled estimates and regional sampling
uncertainty are compared conditionally on those inputs.

Both sets of modeled densities use the same mean/zero-inflation/dispersion
likelihood structure and prior distributions. Nevertheless, the regional
adult-only, single-year fit lacks the PEV model's dataset-level hierarchy;
the comparison is conditional on that necessary adaptation. Marginal
taxon-specific intervals should not be interpreted as a family-wide test of
all taxa or as evidence of ecological equivalence when they include zero.

# Reproducibility

To render from the project root:

```r
rmarkdown::render(
  "analysis/drm_regional_comparison.Rmd",
  output_dir = "outputs/drm_regional_comparison",
  knit_root_dir = getwd()
)
```

The first run fits the regional model using CmdStan. Later runs reuse the
signature-matched fit in the existing ignored `outputs/cache/` directory.
Set `params = list(refit_model = TRUE)` to refit explicitly. Inputs, site
exclusions, classification, effort, weights, diagnostics, posterior summaries,
and comparisons are exported under `outputs/drm_regional_comparison/`.

```{r session-information}
writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()), file.path(output_dir, "sessionInfo.txt"))
sessionInfo()
```
